history.event: Claude refinement: 19 line(s) suggested — Mainly garbled words corrected from the image and the legal-record formula (giudice, podesta, firēze, chasa, suggello, credito, furono, rogate, sandra), the year 1493 and the figure 37 in both the margin and the main text, and the opening R of Ricordo, which falls outside the box. | layout: l8: the large initial R of 'Ricordo' lies mostly outside the box; it is included in the suggested text; l10: this box holds only the letter d at the end of the line of l9 (start of 'd una chasa'), not the denari sign 𝒹; it could be merged into l9; l20: the box sits on an empty area near the foot of the page (only a faint show-through mark); '5' is probably a Kraken hallucination and the box can be deleted; l2–l7: marginal note in the left margin (f. 65r) summarising the main entry; the main entry is l8–l19 | doubts: l3: 'pigirsa' is unclear (possibly 'p gi…' or 'p giusta'); only solui→salui was corrected; l4: the first word 'gnao' is unclear; 'ꝯme decto al' is my reading of the strokes, continuing into 'lamia logia' on l5; l6–l7: in 'pagamāti' and 'ꝓ friāt' the abbreviations are unclear (perhaps 'pagamēto' and 'pressa'); the florin sign may be written 'fl', so check it against the florin-sign rule; l8: 'ꝓsino' (Kraken 'ꝓusino') is uncertain; 'de octobre' may be 'd· octobre'; l11: 'cō' (Kraken 'la'), 'ssitore' and 'chiappi' (Kraken 'cbeappi') are uncertain readings of the surname; l13: 'pregio' or 'piegio': the second letter looks like r; l14: the line ends with a 9-like sign and superscript a, read as mª (monna) before 'sandra' on l15; 'lerasoni' may be 'leragioni'; l16: the first word looks like 'da' (continuing 'avē' at the end of l15) rather than 'Ea'; 'ri' read as mª; l17–l18: 'sūe' and 'sc̄ao' probably stand for sentenza / a contracted form, but the strokes are unclear, so they are left as Kraken read them; l19: 'guni nore fb2 3' (the notary's surname, 'not.' and the closing figures) is unreadable to me; only diovan̄i→giovan̄i was corrected
